title: Frontend Developer
description: Design and build responsive modern web applications using HTML, CSS, JavaScript, TypeScript, React, and Next.js.

nodes.title: Internet & Web Protocols
nodes.description: Understand how the internet works, HTTP protocols, DNS, domain names, and browser rendering engines.

nodes.title: HTML5 & Semantic Markup
nodes.description: Master semantic HTML tags, forms, accessibility (ARIA), and SEO best practices.

nodes.title: CSS3 & Modern Layouts
nodes.description: Learn CSS selectors, Flexbox, Grid, Responsive Web Design, and CSS Animations.

nodes.title: JavaScript (ES6+)
nodes.description: Master core JavaScript syntax, DOM manipulation, Fetch API, Event Loop, Async/Await, and Closures.

nodes.title: TypeScript
nodes.description: Add static typing to JavaScript applications using interfaces, generics, and strict mode.

nodes.title: React.js
nodes.description: Build component-driven user interfaces using React Hooks, State Management, and Context.

nodes.title: Next.js Framework
nodes.description: Build production React applications with Server Components, App Router, and SSR.
